dedupeText: mid century soul dictionary album cover 1960s soul dictionary motif bold primary colors extended sans serif beveled 3d typography flat graphic background the figure leans against the book creating a bridge between the human element and the graphic prop the yellow dictionary face acts as a secondary canvas for high contrast black and white text the heavy red base text provides a structural foundation for the entire vertical stack primary colors red yellow blue are separated by thick black outlines and borders take a central oversized object book box as a text container add a full body figure interacting with it anchor with heavy 3d beveled base text use a primary color triad

retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant 1960s-style album cover featuring a central oversized dictionary prop, a full-body figure in a graduation cap, and heavy beveled block lettering at the base.
triggerTerms: flat cyan and yellow color block
excludeWhen: muted or pastel color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast graphic composition utilizing a 'dictionary' as a central framing device. It features a full-body portrait of a man in a red suit and mortarboard leaning against a giant yellow book, set against a cyan field framed by a yellow and blue border. The bottom is anchored by massive, red, beveled 3D typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The figure leans against the book, creating a bridge between the human element and the graphic prop.
The yellow dictionary face acts as a secondary canvas for high-contrast black and white text.
The heavy red base text provides a structural foundation for the entire vertical stack.
Primary colors (red, yellow, blue) are separated by thick black outlines and borders.
coreInvariants: Oversized yellow dictionary with black spine
Red beveled 3D block lettering at the bottom
Double-line border framing the central scene

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A man in a red suit stands at the left third, leaning on a giant book that occupies the right two-thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive red beveled text at the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top 'Mono/Stereo' header, moves down the dictionary text, to the figure, and ends at the heavy base lettering.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Cyan field surrounding the central figure and book within the border.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation, high value primary colors with heavy black for structural definition.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended Geometric Sans-Serif and Slab Serif
letterConstructionRules: Heavy horizontal extension on display fonts
Sharp, chiseled 3D beveling on base text
Alternating black and white fills for contrast against yellow and black backgrounds
characterSpecificRedesigns: The base text features a 'V-cut' bevel effect to simulate 3D woodblock or stone carving.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extended sans-serif for information paired with heavy beveled slab-serif for the title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century extended sans-serif look of the dictionary text.
Provides the heavy slab-serif skeleton for the beveled base text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A flat cyan background with a yellow and blue double-line border. In the center-right, a large yellow dictionary with a black spine and white 'Vol' text. To the left, a man in a red suit and mortarboard leaning against the book.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add extended sans-serif text in black and white onto the yellow dictionary face. Add large, red, beveled 3D block letters across the bottom edge.

verificationChecks: Is the base text beveled and red?
Is the dictionary yellow with black horizontal bands?
Is the background a flat cyan field?
Is the figure wearing a red suit and graduation cap?

mustAchieve: Clear 3D beveling on the bottom text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the 'dictionary' looks like a 3D object, not a flat rectangle.
Check that the red base text has a distinct chiseled/beveled appearance.
Verify the double-line border is clean and geometric.
Confirm the figure is leaning naturally against the book prop.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a central oversized object (book/box) as a text container + add a full-body figure interacting with it + anchor with heavy 3D beveled base text + use a primary color triad.
